---
title: "Red Book Hints at (Redacted) Changes to FDI Regime"
date: "2010-09-25"
categories: ["Economics", "Foreign Investment"]
---

The Treasury’s [incoming government briefs](http://www.treasury.gov.au/contentitem.asp?ContentID=1875&NavID=007 "incoming government briefs") partly support my criticisms of Australia’s regulatory regime for foreign direct investment, noting the current framework’s ‘reliance on policy unsupported by legislation’ and calls for ‘further changes’ to the regime. The ‘next steps’ section is redacted, however.
